# v1.7.0 — reliable object picking, faster first load, citable State dossiers

## Fixed
- **Clicking and tapping objects.** Hit-testing measured from the browser window instead of the 3D canvas, which sits below the top bar, so every click landed about one top-bar height (61 px) above the dot. Clicks on a dot did nothing, and clicks in the empty space above one selected it. All screen↔scene conversions now use the canvas's own geometry.
- **Overlapping objects.** When several objects are drawn on the same pixels, a click opens the disambiguation list instead of silently picking one.
- **Touch.** The list never opens under the finger, so the opening tap can no longer select a random row.

## Faster
Time to first render on a mid-range phone (slow 4G) drops from 9.7 s to 6.9 s, and the page downloads half as much (1.3 MB instead of 2.7 MB).
- **Compact catalogue.** A lossless transport copy of `sats.json` is 32% smaller. The build and the QA gate verify that it round-trips exactly, and `sats.json` itself remains the archived, citable snapshot.
- **Parallel downloads.** The catalogue and code now download in parallel, and fonts no longer block rendering.
- **WebP Earth textures.** A 2K texture for everyone, with a 4K texture on large desktop screens once the page is live.

## New for researchers
- **Shareable views.** The address bar always encodes the colour mode, filters, selected object and open dossier.
- **CSV export** of the filtered objects, with their canonical TLEs and the snapshot date.
- **State dossiers.** One card per responsible State covers:
  - Article VI supervision burden
  - UN registration gap and registration lag
  - national space legislation
  - constellations

  Each dossier has an OSCOLA 5 footnote pinpointed to it (pinpoint before the DOI, §3.7.1) and the bibliography entry for the instrument (§1.7).

## Accessibility
- Pinch-zoom is enabled.
- Keyboard focus is visible, and Escape closes panels.
- Screen-reader labels have been added.
- `prefers-reduced-motion` is respected.
- Faint text meets WCAG AA contrast.
- First-time visitors see a one-time hint.

## Reliability
- **QA gate.** It now finds where each dot is actually drawn and clicks or taps exactly there, on desktop, zoomed out, and on a touch phone. It also checks view links, the CSV export and the dossiers.
- **Stale data.** The daily refresh fails if the source element sets are more than 3 days old, and a failed scheduled refresh opens a tracking issue.
- **Citation.** The citation never pairs a version with another release's DOI; until Zenodo archives a new version, the concept DOI is cited instead.
- **Discoverability.** Adds `robots.txt`, a sitemap, a 404 page and schema.org Dataset metadata for Google Dataset Search.
